column1: # Key no.71, BnF fr.3995 f.133r (Gallica btv1b525085665 canvas f256; Tomokiyo nevers.htm no.71, Nevers collection, French, figures).
# Copied by F4712-K71 (11 Oct 2026, LANE DEFAULT-A1-1840) from two files READ only, never written:
#   mark/word/person rows: read by eye by F4712-K71 from ciphers/birago-fr3252-1571-72/images/fr3995/read_f133r.jpg (same native
#   crop, one reader, this job); H = code and value both fully on the crop; M = a code or value cut or uncertain.
# Design (key itself): code + mark. kind=letter: plain two-figure code. kind=word: the same figures 11-99 with a DOT above.
# kind=person: the same figures with an OVERLINE (6|7|8 one value, 10|11|12 one value). A figure 1-99 can therefore carry up
# to three values, told apart only by the mark. Word/person columns are only PARTLY on the crop (the 18-51 and 60-91 word codes,
# the town codes and the right-hand person codes are cut or off-crop): a code absent from this file is UNREAD, not absent from the key.
# The alphabet strip ends "x [triangle] | y 97? | z? 90 | [sign: loop with a cross ABOVE]" -- the last column's header is a curl
# (z or &, not settled); the sign is the same shape as f.10r's line-opening sign (DUCH-KEY1B "loop with the cross above").
# The letter file's 97 y / 90 z are M there; kept M here; the sign is added as code S, value "z|&", grade M.
